page_title: WER 3-3 LEV | Werder Bremen v Bayer Leverkusen 30/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' A pass by Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
90+4' 3 - 3 Goal! The rebound fell to Karim Coulibaly (Werder Bremen) and he fired home from close range. The score is 3:3.
90+3' The resulting corner from Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
90+1' Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+1' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mio Backhaus intercepts the ball.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends the corner into the box, but Mio Backhaus intercepts it and averts the threat.
90' The ball is out of play and Bayer Leverkusen manage to earn a corner. A cross from Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
88' The corner from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared away by the defence.
88' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
87' The substitution has been made. Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) has replaced Nathan Tella.
86' Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
85' An attempted cross from Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is cleared.

83' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) latches onto a pass and lets rip with a swerving shot from long range towards the bottom right corner. It's a difficult effort to deal with and Mark Flekken does well to punch it away.
82' Werder Bremen quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

80' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.
79' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
76' 2 - 3 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 2:3.
76' The attendance is 42100.
75' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

74' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
72' Erik ten Hag has decided to substitute Christian Michel Kofane and he is replaced by Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen).
72' The referee signals a substitution. Loic Bade (Bayer Leverkusen) is brought on as a substitute for Axel Tape.
71' Substitution. Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) in, Marco Grull out.
71' It is time for a substitution. Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) is on for Samuel Mbangula.
70' Robin Braun shows a yellow card to Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) for his blatant foul.
69' What a big chance! Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
65' Here is a change. Justin Njinmah is going off and Horst Steffen gives the last tactical orders to Skelly Alvero (Werder Bremen).
65' Here comes a substitution. Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is brought on as a substitute for Patrice Covic.
64' 1 - 3 GOAL! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a real chance, but his penalty strike right into the middle of the net fools Mio Backhaus in goal.
64' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is going to take the penalty!
63' Robin Braun blows his whistle and Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
61' Erik ten Hag has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Claudio Echeverri (Bayer Leverkusen) replacing Malik Tillman.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) will replace Aleix Garcia.
59' A pass by Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
57' Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
57' Unsporting behaviour by Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen).
56' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
54' The resulting corner from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared by the defence.
50' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
49' Patrice Covic (Werder Bremen) jumps into a tackle and Robin Braun signals a foul.
48' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
46' The whistle blows and Robin Braun starts the second half.
45+8' The match has reached half-time.
45+8' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Mark Flekken scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
45+8' A quickly taken corner by Werder Bremen.

45+8' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) sends a direct shot in from the free kick that's in a promising position. The ball sails towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper prevents a goal with a quick save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Werder Bremen are going to take it.
45+7' Robin Braun blows his whistle and signals a foul after Axel Tape (Bayer Leverkusen) brought his opponent down. A free kick to Werder Bremen.
45+7' A player from Bayer Leverkusen commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
45+6' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

45+6' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the free kick from the edge of the box but the defensive wall makes the block. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
45+4' The referee shows the yellow card to Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen).
45+3' Patrice Covic (Werder Bremen) tackles a bit over-zealously and Robin Braun blows for a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 2 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) high into the middle of the goal, giving goalkeeper Mark Flekken no chance!
44' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
43' It’s a PENALTY to Werder Bremen after the VAR review!
43' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Werder Bremen! Let's see what he decides.
42' Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
37' Yellow card. Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

35' 0 - 2 Spectacular goal! Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and fires the ball in off the bottom of the left post, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
34' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
33' Robin Braun blows the whistle, Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) is penalised for a foul. The referee signals a free kick. Werder Bremen are going to take it from long range.
29' A crossfield pass from Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
25' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
23' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
21' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
18' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the right post.

14' Nice move, nice attempt! Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.
10' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
9' A dangerous looking corner kick from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared to safety by the defence.
9' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Bayer Leverkusen force their opponents to concede a corner.
8' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

5' 0 - 1 Goal! Nathan Tella displays great vision and sends a pass to Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 0:1.
4' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Werder Bremen will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Robin Braun.
